title: SPLINE artifact availability and GDAL fit-only consumer crosswalk
mode: Primary-source issue/spec/documentation review plus local plan/source crosswalk; research-only
scope: Refresh ACadSharp issue #1299's evidence tier after confirming that its public body links a source-DWG/output-DXF archive.
Compare that report with GDAL issue #10397 and current GDAL DXF driver behavior to identify consumer-side diagnostic confounders.
Refine the optional SPLINE investigation order while preserving the no-external-fixture policy, reduced validation cadence, and support-claim boundaries.

sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-19; it identifies ACadSharp v3.8.0 NuGet and an AutoCAD-created source DWG. The archive link was not downloaded or inspected.
sources.observed: The issue says conversion to DXF produces bad spline data that a later GDAL-to-GeoJSON conversion rejects, and attaches a ZIP said to contain both source DWG and output DXF. The issue body does not identify the GDAL version/options, failing SPLINE handle, group arrays, full diagnostic, or an independent expected curve. This is artifact-available but uninspected peer evidence, not a reproduced malformed-DXF case.

sources.revision: Issue and current stable DXF-driver documentation reviewed 2026-10-19; issue #10397 remains open and names GDAL 3.9.0 on Windows 11.
sources.observed: The issue shows a degree-3 SPLINE with five fit points (group 74 and repeated 11/21/31 tuples) and no shown control-point count/data or knot array, then reports a DXF reader error. Current documentation says SPLINE is tessellated to an OGR LINESTRING and describes eight output vertices per control point. This is a GDAL-specific fit-only failure shape/projection limit, not normative validity evidence and not proof about ACadSharp #1299.

sources.revision: Public SPLINE DXF group-code reference reviewed 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: The reference separately lists group 73/control points and 74/optional fit points, plus their respective tuples. It documents fields, not a complete mathematical-validity rule or fit-only interpolation algorithm.

localEvidence: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing PAR-22/7H/7I/7AB owners include explicit-73=0 generated fit-only ASCII/Binary DXF controls and a following-record sentinel.
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: the existing research notes distinguish strict DXF structure, OGR projection, field preservation, and curve semantics.
AGENTS.md: DWG parseDwg changes require ODA v5.4.1 review and sample-trace support; external testing drawings must not be committed unless they satisfy the user's admitted-fixture rule.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing SPLINE diagnostic route: ACadSharp #1299 is artifact-available but uninspected, and the separate GDAL fit-only issue prevents treating GDAL rejection as a syntax or semantic verdict. Adds a provenance-aware, no-fixture diagnostic sequence without changing implementation priority or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source issue/spec/documentation review and local static crosswalk
method.limitations: The ACadSharp archive link was visible but not fetched, so its hash, provenance, rights, DWG version, failing entity, and actual output fields are unknown. GDAL issue #10397 is a separate report and does not establish the cause of #1299. Autodesk's group table does not supply a complete spline validity/interpolation rule.

implementationReadiness: If peer-artifact analysis is later needed, verify provenance/rights first, then bind archive and extracted-file hashes, producer/release, DWG version, exact GDAL binary/version/options, and diagnostics; use disposable scratch only.
Validate DXF group syntax and framing independently before running an OGR geometry projection.
Compare source/output SPLINEs by identity and exact ordered group arrays; keep omitted group 73 distinct from explicit 73=0.
Use GDAL only as a version-pinned projection consumer; use independent NURBS evaluation or a justified native/interpolation witness for curve semantics.
Only a reproduced local defect may trigger a focused generated in-memory regression; consult ODA v5.4.1 before changing DWG parseDwg code.
Keep peer drawings out of the repository and retain focused-selector plus owning-CTest validation; defer composed peer/native checks to the planned checkpoint.
